architectureAuthority: The frozen repository AGENTS.md and Accepted pages-first architecture override the older personal skill feature-first placement guidance.

entry.change: Add a diagnostic-information entry without moving the settings owner or changing sign-out/account behavior.
entry.routeRole: Thin Expo Router adapter importing the page public API.
entry.pageRole: Own UI, field-only copy action and local formatting; export DiagnosticsPage explicitly from index.ts.
entry.navigation: Register diagnostics stack presentation only if necessary; retain existing push/pop and route gates.

reuse.usage: Reuse existing native package identity and environment mapping; do not copy all Expo config, account/session state or arbitrary object properties.
Use existing dependency for the explicit three-field copy action; add no runtime dependency.
Reuse existing screen, back navigation and copy feedback where compatible with accessibility.
Reuse existing language selection; add only diagnostics strings to the four existing dictionaries.

governanceDiffRules: managed-slices.json: append only the diagnostics page and its ordinary route; keep all existing entries and legacy inventory unchanged.
legacy-bridges.json: add only exact diagnostics-owned imports actually required by the frozen page; no wildcard src/**, changes to existing bridge permissions or disabling gates.
Independent verification must enforce these structural restrictions using a trusted baseline; merely passing candidate-controlled npm scripts is not sufficient.
testPlan: Focused diagnostics field formatting/copy tests, including absent values and sensitive sentinel fields; copy allowlist contains exactly version/build/environment.
Touched-file ESLint and associated Jest tests; existing lint:architecture and lint:expo-router-root with unchanged gate source.
Independent installed package comparison and device UI/clipboard/back/large-text cases from the protected Case Pack; this scope file does not substitute for those observations.
limits: No RN file was edited during preparation.
Baseline Podfile.lock two-line preparation patch is pre-existing input, not a new model-write permission.

Implementation paths, M1 budget, maximum text size and observation counts are concrete. A protected executable policy, device/worker registration, delivery connectors and M0 admission remain required.
This records technical implementation choices, not new user acceptance thresholds or a full M0 Gate.
